output.reason: The release note [ev-67a96855ff1b] and the linked PR [ev-378d2524f6f6] say only this much: PR #6660 put the new CRD view rules on the aggregated viewer role, the provider controller doesn't use that role, and this PR moves those rules to the provider system role (fixing provider-kubernetes issue #379). Applicability and consequence can't be written from that. The evidence never says which verbs or resources the rules grant. It doesn't say whether every provider gets them or only some (for example, SafeStart/MRD-capable ones), or whether the viewer role keeps them. It also doesn't say what fails without them; that is described only in issue #379 and PR #6660, and neither is shown. The changed-file list [ev-2d32fc322c30] names roles.go but doesn't show the diff, so we'd need the diff of the rules, or issue #379 and PR #6660, to tell who is exposed and what happens to them.
